recommendations.name: Whiskey Sour
ingredients: lemon wheel and cherry for garnish
recommendations.method: Dry shake egg white (if using) first, then add ice and all other ingredients and shake vigorously for 15 seconds, strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice
recommendations.why_this_works: This classic cocktail offers universal appeal with its balanced sweet-tart profile and moderate ABV, making it an excellent choice when preferences are unknown.

recommendations.name: Aperol Spritz
recommendations.method: Build in a wine glass filled with ice, add Aperol first, then Prosecco, top with soda water, stir gently and garnish with orange slice
recommendations.why_this_works: This low-ABV aperitif cocktail is crowd-pleasing, refreshing, and versatile enough for any occasion from casual to celebratory.

recommendations.name: Classic Daiquiri
recommendations.method: Shake all ingredients with ice for 10-12 seconds until well-chilled, strain into a coupe glass
recommendations.why_this_works: This three-ingredient classic showcases simplicity and balance, offering a refreshing spirit-forward option that works across different moods and settings.
